title: Fix Repo Wide Nx Cargo Package Name Mismatch
description: Fix repo-wide nx↔Cargo package-name mismatch breaking `test` for ~150 Rust projects
summary: Implemented centralized Cargo package name resolution in `resolveCargoPackageNames` inside `repo/lib/js/index.ts` (`🧰️framework/🛍️product/🦑️repo/🔨️module/📚️lib/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📦️index.ts`). `runCargoTestBudgeted` and `runCargoLint` now map short crate library names, directory slugs, and legacy package names (such as `db_actor`, `architect_spine`, `energy_engine`, `ui_wgpu`, `framework_editor`, `framework_surface_node_graph`, etc.) directly to their real `[package]` names in `Cargo.toml` (e.g. `semio-framework-os-kernel-db-actor`, `semio-s-plugin-architect-spine-module`, `semio-s-plugin-energy-engine`). Verified end-to-end with unit tests in `index.test.ts` and test runs across affected projects and `verify gate`.
